comparison.objective: Close and latch ordered double enclosure doors, versus preassembling a collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Large articulated-door sequencing, bolting and latching; candidate is small-part eccentric insertion with tilt and roll.
comparison.success_condition: Doors must close in forced leaf order and remain bolted/latched; candidate requires released collet retention and pull verification. Candidate snap-force limits are absent.
comparison.reason: Different mechanism, scale, sequence and end state.
